task: Redesigned the investor syndicate platform from auto-project-creation with email ingestion to manual project creation with rich asset upload, Neo4j-backed knowledge graph traversal, and real-time graph visualization in the frontend during investor conversations.
discussion_summary: The project pivoted from a passive email-ingestion model to an active asset-driven workflow. Syndicate members now manually create projects, upload any file type (pitch decks, MP3s, images, Excel), which get processed into a Neo4j knowledge graph. When investors converse (text or voice), the system traverses the graph in real-time and streams the traversal path to the frontend for live visualization. This replaces the previous form-only input model and makes the reasoning transparent to investors. Session 1 identified the need for Neo4j and frontend graph animation; this session rewrote all LLD files to reflect the new architecture and created a comprehensive SVG diagram showing the full lifecycle from auth through final investor analysis.

Created 02-asset-pipeline.md documenting manual upload, per-type extractors (PDF, MP3, images, Excel, video), chunking, embedding, and Neo4j ingestion
Created 03-knowledge-graph.md with Neo4j node/edge schema, BFS traversal algorithm, SSE stream format, GraphRAG query flow, and frontend visualization spec
Rewrote 04-conversation-engine.md to cover text + voice input, Whisper STT, SSE hookup, and how conversations capture investor views for group analysis
Updated 07-database.md with new Postgres tables (conversation_sessions, conversation_messages, updated assets) and Neo4j schema alongside
Rewrote 11-frontend.md with D3.js force graph, traversal animation (node pulse + edge draw), two-panel conversation layout, voice recording via MediaRecorder API, and traversal live feed sidebar
Generated comprehensive lld-diagram.html with 157 SVG rectangles, 58 arrows, and 68 marker references showing full lifecycle from auth to final investor analysis in one zoomable canvas
Removed email ingestion and notetaker webhook files entirely from the architecture

decisions.decision: Use Neo4j as the knowledge graph backend instead of Postgres pgvector adjacency tables
decisions.reason: Neo4j provides native graph traversal, better performance for complex relationship queries, and cleaner visualization of traversal paths for the frontend

decisions.decision: Remove email ingestion and auto-project-creation entirely
decisions.reason: Manual project creation gives syndicate members explicit control over what data enters the system; auto-creation was passive and error-prone

decisions.decision: Make asset upload the primary input mechanism, supporting any file type (PDF, MP3, images, Excel, video)
decisions.reason: Investors have diverse materials (pitch decks, founder recordings, location photos, financial models); a single asset type would be limiting

decisions.decision: Stream knowledge graph traversal to the frontend in real-time via SSE
decisions.reason: Investors need to see exactly which information the system used to answer their question; this builds trust and transparency

decisions.decision: Use D3.js force-directed graph for frontend visualization with node pulse and edge draw animations
decisions.reason: D3 is battle-tested for interactive graphs; force-directed layout makes relationships intuitive; animations make traversal visible without overwhelming the viewer

decisions.decision: Support both text and voice input for investor conversations via Whisper STT
decisions.reason: Investors may prefer speaking (faster, more natural); voice input removes friction and captures tone/emphasis that text misses

decisions.decision: Capture investor views through conversation itself rather than form responses alone
decisions.reason: Conversational input is richer (questions reveal thesis, follow-ups show depth of thinking); forms are rigid and often incomplete

relational_files.why: Auth is the entry point to the system; all other LLD files assume auth is already handled

behavioral_preferences.rule: Provide one comprehensive diagram showing the entire system lifecycle in a single view; avoid fragmented ASCII art or multiple separate diagrams
When architecture changes significantly, rewrite all affected LLD files immediately rather than patching incrementally
Use imperative, direct language in handovers; avoid hedging or tentative phrasing
